# TreeView 1.0.2

点回树上任意一个节点，现在真的会落到那个节点上 —— 这一版把 0.1.7 上「点回去却停在新会话」的几个成因逐个修掉，并让切换过程不再闪。

## 修的是什么

在 DSH 0.1.7 上，点树上的节点后有时会停在你刚离开的那个会话上（尤其快速连点、或点的那条已经被收起时）。这不止一个原因，逐个查出来的是：

- **解除归档只写了宿主，没告诉客户端。** 宿主路由确实把会话从归档集合里拿出来了（实测返回 `{unarchived: true}`，payload 也随之从 `archived: true` 翻成 `false`），但客户端自己的会话名录仍认为它是归档的，0.1.7 的 `openSession` 就一直拒绝它，导航从未发生。现在优先调用应用自己的客户端接口 `uiWorkspace.unarchiveSession()` —— 侧栏「取消归档」走的也是它，它会同时刷新名录；没有该接口的旧宿主才退回宿主路由。
- **名录追赶期间的重试会盖掉后一次点击。** 重试是必需的（刚从归档里出来的会话，客户端名录会晚一步），但只有最新一次导航可以重试：否则前一次点击的重试会在后一次点击之后落地，把视图拽回你已经离开的那条 —— 这正是「快速点击还是会回到新会话」。
- **应用的右侧栏会吃掉切换。** 主会话变化时，右侧栏要重同步它自己持有的会话视图；一个滞后的同步会把刚创建、还在打开中的视图剪掉，控制台留下 `Sidebar Session opening failed: … is released`，主视图因此没有落到目标上。切换发出后约 400ms 再幂等补发一次，等同步尘埃落定。
- **「这是不是当前版本」曾相信视图属性。** 视图可能保留它挂载时的那个 sessionId，于是「点回原节点」被判成「已经在本屏」而什么都不做。现在改为问应用本身（主视图 retain 的是哪条）；没有该信号的宿主才退回属性判断。
- **闪一下。** 点击会在同一 tick 把界面翻到「对话」标签，而会话还没切过去，于是旧会话闪一下。现在等应用真的到了目标会话再翻标签（最多等 3 秒，之后无论如何都翻）。

## 出问题时看得见

每次点击都会在控制台打印一行 `[dsh-tree-view] click: <节点> | prop-session=<视图认为的会话> | archived=<是否归档>`，紧跟着是这次点击走了哪条分支（已在本屏 / 打开 / 失败）。切换失败会写明原因，不再无声无息。

## 验证

- **实机**：这些成因是在 DSH 0.1.7-rc.1 上逐个复现并修掉的；当前运行的宿主已升到 **0.2.0-rc.1**，同一套行为在其中复查过（两个方向的点击、点归档版本切出去、快速两连击，以及 60ms 采样确认标签不再提前翻），宿主端的归档 / 解除归档往返也在 0.2.0-rc.1 上再次实测通过。
- **单元测试**：`npm test` 16 个文件全绿（树过滤器 30 条），其中三条专门对应上面第 2、4、5 条。
- **CI**：宿主矩阵 `0.1.5-rc.2` × `0.1.7-rc.1` × `0.2.0-rc.1`，Windows 与 Linux 各跑一遍。

## 兼容区间

`engines.dsh` 从 `>=0.1.5-rc.2 <0.2.0-0` 放宽到 **`>=0.1.5-rc.2 <0.3.0-0`**，并把 `0.2.0-rc.1` 加进 CI 的宿主矩阵。0.2.0 保留 0.1.7 那一代的会话导航（`uiWorkspace.openSession`），树依赖的归档 API 仍是工作区注册表那一套 —— 区间里每一条宿主线都真的跑一遍验收，而不是只写在文档里。

# TreeView 1.0.2 (English)

Clicking a node now lands on that node — this release fixes, one by one, the causes behind "clicking back stops on the new conversation" on 0.1.7, and stops the switch from flashing.

## What was wrong

On DSH 0.1.7, clicking a node could leave you on the session you had just left (especially with quick successive clicks, or when the clicked version had been collected). There was more than one cause:

- **The unarchive only reached the host, not the client.** The host route really did take the session out of the archive set (`{unarchived: true}`, and the payload flipped from `archived: true` to `false`), but the client's own session catalogue still counted it as archived and 0.1.7's `openSession` kept refusing it, so the navigation never happened. It now goes through the app's own client call, `uiWorkspace.unarchiveSession()` — the same one the sidebar's "unarchive" uses, and it refreshes the catalogue with it. Hosts without that call fall back to the route.
- **Retries while the catalogue caught up overrode the next click.** The retry is necessary (a session just out of the archive is a step behind in the client catalogue), but only the newest navigation may retry: otherwise an older click's retry lands after the newer click and drags the view back to the version you left — the "fast clicking still jumps to the new conversation" report.
- **The app's right sidebar could drop the switch.** When the main session changes, the right sidebar re-syncs the session views it retains, and a stale sync prunes the freshly-created view while it is still opening (`Sidebar Session opening failed: … is released`), so the main view never reached the target. The switch is now re-issued idempotently once, about 400 ms later.
- **"Is this the current version" trusted a view prop.** The view can keep the sessionId it mounted with, so clicking the node you came from was read as "already on screen" and did nothing. It now asks the app (which session the main view retains), falling back to the prop only where that signal does not exist.
- **The flash.** A click flipped the UI to the Chat tab in the same tick, before the session had switched, showing the session being left for a moment. The tab now opens once the app is really on the target, and at the latest after three seconds.

## Visible when it goes wrong

Every click logs one line to the console — `[dsh-tree-view] click: <node> | prop-session=<what the view thinks> | archived=<archived?>` — followed by the branch it took (already on screen / open / failed). A failed switch now says why instead of failing silently.

## Validation

- **On a real host**: each cause was reproduced and fixed on DSH 0.1.7-rc.1, and the same behaviour was re-checked on **0.2.0-rc.1**, which is what is running now — clicks in both directions, a click out of an archived version, a fast two-click, and the 60 ms sampling run that shows the tab no longer opens early. The host-side archive/unarchive round trip was measured again on 0.2.0-rc.1 as well.
- **Unit tests**: `npm test`, all 16 files pass (30 cases in the tree filter), three of them for causes 2, 4 and 5 above.
- **CI**: host matrix `0.1.5-rc.2` × `0.1.7-rc.1` × `0.2.0-rc.1`, on Windows and Linux.

## Supported range

`engines.dsh` widens from `>=0.1.5-rc.2 <0.2.0-0` to **`>=0.1.5-rc.2 <0.3.0-0`**, and `0.2.0-rc.1` joins CI's host matrix. 0.2.0 keeps the 0.1.7 generation of session navigation (`uiWorkspace.openSession`) and the workspace registry API the tree archives through, so every host line in that range really runs the acceptance rather than being claimed in prose.
